shots.typography: Native app UI text: very small regular sans-serif numbers and account labels, uppercase column headers; bold for total rows, light-blue fill on total and forecast cells. At full-window scale most of the grid is not legible. No added motion-graphics type.
shots.what_happens: Cut to the full-window card showing a blank page with a loading spinner, which resolves into the P&L sheet about 1 s in, as the narration says 'P&L sheet. This is the budget for the complete year for the total company' (w267-w281). The sheet holds static; at the end the cursor moves to the Working Budget version selector in the top-right.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the drop-shadowed recording card centred on white with the blue bottom arc, play a 1 s spinner state, then swap to the loaded spreadsheet and hold for about 3 s while the cursor travels to the top-right selector.

shots.focal_element: The open version dropdown tree, with the 'May Forecast' row highlighted under the cursor
shots.transition_other: Continuous camera push-in toward the top-right version selector from the full-window framing; no visible cut
shots.typography: Native app UI text in small regular sans-serif, title case; folder names in grey, the current version (Working Budget) in bold, the hovered row on a solid light-blue highlight bar. Legible only because of the zoom.
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes in on the top-right as the version dropdown opens; the cursor runs down the Bottom Up folder past Working Budget and settles on the new May Forecast row while the narrator says the drop-down now shows an additional version called May Forecast (w282-w296). The frame holds on the highlighted row for several seconds; an impact-like sound candidate (x003) lands near the end of the shot as the row is chosen.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the recording card from 1.0 to about 2.2 with an ease-in-out over roughly 0.6 s, anchored on the top-right dropdown, then hold while a highlight bar steps from row to row under the cursor and stops on the target item.

shots.focal_element: The zoomed top-right of the app window while the sheet reloads (loading spinner, then the version selector and FY columns)
shots.typography: Native app UI text in small regular sans-serif; white uppercase 'LEVELS' label and title-case values on the blue toolbar; numeric grid in the same face with bold totals.
shots.what_happens: A sub-second bridge (about 0.8 s) while still zoomed in: after May Forecast is picked the page goes blank with a loading spinner, then the sheet starts to redraw; the selector label still reads Working Budget in the keyframe. Narration continues 'a combination of four months' (w299-w302).
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 0.8 s zoomed hold of the card showing a centred spinner on a blank page, then a hard swap to the redrawn grid before the camera pulls out.

shots.focal_element: The full P&L sheet now on the May Forecast version, with January to April actuals columns followed by plan months
shots.transition_other: Fast pull-out from the zoomed close-up back to the full-window framing; the move itself is not resolvable at 2 fps

shots.typography: Native app UI text: very small regular sans-serif numbers and labels, uppercase month headers; actuals months appear in a different (green-tinted) number style from the plan months, total rows bold on light-blue fill. Not legible at this scale except in the keyframe.
shots.what_happens: A long static hold (about 10 s) on the full window with the version selector reading May Forecast, while the narrator explains it combines four months of actuals and eight months of plan copied from the working budget and that all sheets, reports and dashboards can use it (w303-w330). The cursor barely moves; in the last frame the blue left navigation menu opens over a darkened page.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the full-window card for about 10 s with no camera motion, then slide in a solid blue left nav panel with a dark overlay over the rest of the app in the final 0.5 s.

shots.focal_element: The blue left navigation panel with Reports hovered and its white Reports submenu list
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the nav menu that opened at the end of the previous shot; the boundary is a large luminance change from the dark overlay rather than an edit
shots.typography: Native app nav text in small regular sans-serif, title case: white on solid blue for the main menu, dark on white for the submenu with a bold 'Reports' header; the hovered item gets a darker blue bar.
shots.what_happens: With the page dimmed behind it, the cursor moves from Sheets to Reports in the nav panel and the submenu switches to a long list of reports; the cursor then crosses to the submenu while the narrator says 'We can analyze the differences in the key financial statements' (w331-w340). In the last frame a selection is made and a new, lighter report view starts loading.
shots.build_rebuild: On the full-window card, keep a 70% dark overlay over the app area, show a solid blue left nav at about 15% width plus a white submenu column, and swap the submenu contents instantly when the hovered nav item changes.
